notes.title: Feb 2025 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed sizing issue with NPC dialogue box. Size will now adjust to fill the window
[*] Increased gold received from enemies 
[*] Reduced the cost of many items
[*] Fixed issue to prevent accidental deaths after a boss has been defeated
[/list]

notes.title: Updates for Jan 24th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed DOT issue with Barrel Shark Trio
[*] Fixed Bug with the First Mate Boss fight
[*] Adjusted damage collider on Kraken battle
[*] Slowed Speed of Small Krakens during Kraken battle to give time to dodge
[*] Minor tweaks to Audio and animation
[/list]

notes.title: Updates for November 25th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Melee attack animations and feedback have been fine-tuned.
[*] Platforming has been improved, adding more "stick" to landings to reduce slipperiness when jumping.
[*] Most enemies no longer re-spawn unless you return to the ship or re-load.
[*] Various enemy animations and visual effects have been upgraded.
[*] Minor collision and visual bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: May 26th Update
notes.content:
[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] VFX added to various traps/hazards to act as warning/tell
[*] Added visual to help distinguish return to ship and inventory at camps
[*] Added some tips for hazard/traps
[*] enhanced the VFX rain for some levels
[*] Added SFX to acid jumping area to signal it starting
[*] Added health replenish after some boss fights
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved some of the boss attack transitions
[*] Fixed an out of place rendering on caverns
[*] fixed some canon traps were not firing correctly
[*] New Shark dog missing damage number popups
[*] Player gravity was incorrect on a few zones
[/list]

notes.title: MAy 4th Update
notes.content:
Boss encounter adjustments
UI KB mapping fix
Minor enemy path fixes
Various minor adjustments to render layers

notes.title: Minor Update April 29th
notes.content:
Added KB mapping for looking up and down
Fixed unintended collisions with slanted ceilings
Fixed broken and missing KB mapping keys
Fixed a bug with KB jump height wasn't based upon press length

notes.title: April 26 Updates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Enhancements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]     Increase in movement speed
[*]     Increase in gravity to reduce floaty feel
[*]     Rework of Shark Dog enemy, including new art and animations
[*]     Enhancements to Shark Gunner art and VFX
[*]     New enemy subtype: Heavy Armor Skeleton with a Flamethrower
[*]     Slight increase in attack radius
[*]     Several tweaks to enemy outgoing damage; in some cases, it was too much and in others too little
[*]     Several minor tweaks to various enemy animations to improve quality
[*]     Added some help text for first charm unlocks
[*]     Minor improvements to the art of the Item Equipped screen in the selection menu
[*]     Adjustments to player falling animation
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]     Max velocity cap on falling was not working as intended
[*]     Some spawn locations were outside the plane of level, causing player to experience parallax issues
[*]     Missing SFX on some particles
[/list]

[b]**Note** Updates are not applied to the Demo but are coming soon[/b]

notes.title: April 21st Minor Update
notes.content:
Small bug fixes
[list]
[*] Issue with map menu resolved.
[*] reward for first shark boss changed to chest.
[*] various other very minor changes.
[/list]

notes.title: April 9th Updates
notes.content:
[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing door in Shipwreck zone for returning to the landing.
[*] Resolved an issue where the Select menu and interactable menus were overlapping, causing unintended issues.
[*] Corrected the vsync setting, which was not correctly reselecting the selected setting on reload.
[*] Fixed instances where the Navy soldier's sword was hot on death.
[*] Addressed minor issues with one of the Shipwreck Zone's Final Optional bosses.
[*] Rectified several minor rendering issues.
[*] Fixed minor contact issues with walls.
[*] Added missing visual effects to traps.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tips to the loading screen.
[*] Included various sound effects for enemies.
[*] Implemented additional animations for enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: March 30 Updates
notes.content:
[b]DEMO coming soon![/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing camps to incorrectly close.
[*] Fixed bug with the wheel of fortune game.
[*] Added missing platform to mermaid door.
[*] Added camps, flags, and fishing icons to maps.
[*] Fixed Navy soldier attack not colliding.
[*] Added more telegraphs to bosses.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes March 27
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]     The starting area has been redesigned to enhance understanding of gameplay mechanics. For example, players are informed they can block projectiles, attacks regenerate cannonballs, and to avoid contact damage.
[*]     Environmental hazards and dangerous objects have received improved visual effects and audio cues to clearly indicate their danger.
[*]     Added a low-health visual indicator to alert players when their health drops to one jar.
[*]     Implemented messaging on the map to indicate when maps have not been acquired yet.
[*]     Enhanced several character animations, with more improvements planned.
[*]     Replaced several out-of-place sound effects, with more replacements planned.
[*]     Improved and added additional visual effects.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*]     The pirate boss on the starting island was colliding incorrectly.
[*]     There was an issue with colliders on the sewer hazards, causing them to collide incorrectly with the player.
[/list]
